content.comment_body: Hello, I want to set a numeric input on the [product_name] HMI (vw6) and use it as a reference for a counter's ON/OFF status. I've created an analog input in [product_name] at vw6, but I'm unsure how to proceed from here. Best regards, [user_name]

A counter value or its ON/OFF parameters require a 32-bit unsigned integer. For this, you'll need a double word in the VM (VD) area, such as VD6 (which combines VW6 and VW8). Note that VD values cannot be read with a NAI; NAI only supports reading 16-bit signed values.

Hello, I've successfully used vw from [product_name] to the HMI without issues in the opposite direction. Could you advise which blocks to use in [product_name] and how to connect them? Best regards, [user_name]
I've created an example for [product_name] engineering software version [version_no].

Here's the example: You only need to establish the connection in [product_name] engineering software, not in [product_name] configuration tool. In [product_name] configuration tool, review ParameterVM Mapping.

Hello, I've set up my counter starting with m10, inputs I3 and I6, and counter C001. In the block properties, I can set and reference the ON/OFF state, and I'd like to input the number via the HMI. The logic beneath the counter is just for testing purposes.
Did you see the example I made for you?
Hello, All I see in your example is what happens within [product_name], but there isn’t any network output from the counter or a way to reference it over the network. Best regards, [user_name]
Have you checked the Parameter VM Mapping? Tools > Parameter VM Mapping.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are trying to set up numeric inputs from a HMI to serve as counter references within a [product_name] controller for ON/OFF control. The workflow for transferring values between the HMI and [product_name] controller is not straightforward, particularly when it comes to handling data types (VW/DW) and selecting the appropriate blocks or mapping options in [product_name] configuration software. There is also confusion about configuring network outputs from counters and how to properly use Parameter VM Mapping features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a simple and clear tutorial on how to connect numeric inputs from an HMI to [product_name] counters, including step-by-step advice on configuring connections and references within [product_name] software.
